title: Pin/verify checksum for renode-latest.linux-portable.tar.gz download in docs workflow
description: Review finding (z3jb round): docs/renode-workflow.md:456 fetches https://builds.renode.io/renode-latest.linux-portable.tar.gz with no checksum verification — a floating dependency surface larger than the uv pin fixed in z3jb. Options: pin a specific Renode version tarball with sha256, or verify against a published checksum. Pre-existing, unrelated to z3jb's one-line change; tracked so it is not lost.
close_reason: Pinned the documented Renode install to 1.16.1 (the version the fleet AMI validates, per docs/simulation-infrastructure-deployment.md) with sha256 verification: docs/renode-workflow.md:456-459 now downloads renode-1.16.1.linux-portable.tar.gz, gates extraction with 'echo <sha256>  <file> | sha256sum -c -' (hash 1a532d4b5b82de0dd154970c401e0c7b0e498d17304b2cecc007e306c8f9617c computed from the actual upstream artifact — external oracle, downloaded and verified live; sha256sum -c run against the real tarball returned OK), then extracts; PATH glob renode_*_portable unchanged and confirmed matching (tar top-level renode_1.16.1_portable). Fail-closed: wget 404 or hash mismatch aborts the step before tar under Actions bash -e. 3x codereview: correctness PASS (kimi-k3 retry; its hash-literal caveat closed by my live verification), security PASS (kimi-k3; pin+hash prevents tampered tarball reaching tar; TOFU residual acceptable for docs), edge-cases: reviewer timed out once then delivered — sha256sum present (coreutils), no renode-latest left anywhere (grep-verified repo-wide), two real observations filed as follow-up beads (real workflows fetch same version from GitHub releases WITHOUT hash; doc version-check line should name 1.16.1).
